errors: test_prior.py first asserted that rank-2 hard-impute recovers a hidden cell of a rank-1 matrix; it does not, because column-centring adds a rank. The test was rewritten and the finding reported in LOG.md (prediction 5)
A first draft of the LOG outcome claimed 10 of the 12 large-bias groups were 2016-24 cells before checking; the data said 3 of 12. It was corrected before commit
